signals.title: Saved workspace filters reset after reopening
signals.expected: Saved filters should still be present the next time the workspace is opened.
signals.observed: Users report that saved filters are missing after closing and reopening the workspace, while a plain refresh keeps them.
signals.evidence_rationale: Independent reports from different users describing the same loss of saved filters across a reopen rather than a refresh.
signals.suggested_next_step: Attempt reproduction by saving filters, fully closing the workspace, and reopening it in a new session.

signals.title: Bulk export completes without producing a file
signals.expected: Starting a bulk export should produce a downloadable file.
signals.observed: One user repeatedly reports that bulk export appears to finish but no file is produced and no error is shown.
signals.evidence_rationale: All supporting messages come from a single account, so the reports are consistent but narrow.
signals.suggested_next_step: Check export job logs for silent failures and confirm whether the behaviour is account specific.

signals.title: Two-factor setup rejects valid authenticator codes
signals.expected: A correct authenticator code should complete two-factor enrolment.
signals.observed: Several users report that every code entered during two-factor setup is rejected as invalid, including after generating a fresh secret.
signals.evidence_rationale: Four distinct accounts described the same rejection within a short window, one of them noting a synchronised clock.
signals.suggested_next_step: Verify the enrolment code verification window and secret storage for recently created enrolments.

signals.title: Mobile application startup time improved
signals.observed: Several users independently report that the mobile application now opens noticeably faster than before.
signals.evidence_rationale: Unprompted positive reports from separate accounts about the same startup behaviour.
signals.suggested_next_step: Confirm which change affected cold start so the improvement is not regressed later.

signals.title: Search may return previously deleted results
signals.expected: Deleted items should not appear in search results.
signals.observed: Two users vaguely recall seeing deleted items in search results, and neither could describe how to reproduce it.
signals.evidence_rationale: Only two uncertain reports with no reproduction details.
signals.suggested_next_step: Ask both reporters for approximate timestamps before investigating index invalidation.
